The software product **Babel** at **babeljs.io** is an open-source project directly developed and provided by the **Babel Team** (originally created by **Sebastian McKenzie** and maintained by the Babel core maintainers and open-source contributors).

### Supporting Evidence
* **Official Website (`babeljs.io`):** The site and project announcements identify the developer/maintainer group as the *Babel Team*: *"We're a small group of volunteers that spend their free time maintaining this project, funded by the community"* and *"We, the Babel core team... Reach out to us directly or by email at team@babeljs.io"*.
* **Official License & Repository (`github.com/babel/babel`):** The official MIT license states: *"Copyright (c) 2014-present Sebastian McKenzie and other contributors"*, and package distributions list the author/publisher as *"The Babel Team"*.
